vb_textbox.text: You need to select the gnomes at random initially, to try and decide which gnome is giving more mushrooms. Once you've found one that is giving higher than 4 mushrooms stick with it until the mushrooms drop below 4 when you need to switch. You need to be prepared to change frequently. Sometimes the gnomes may give a similar output, if this is the case you need to go back to clicking at random until you find a high scoring gnome.
